title: Blood Blade
summary: Surrounded by scavenging ghouls, Ha-Jun unleashes the primary combat form of the Ring of Hollow Blood—condensing his own fluid blood into the razor-sharp crystalline katana: The Sanguine Fang.

panels.action: Two remaining ghouls crawl along opposite walls, their jagged fangs dripping acidic venom onto the floor.
panels.prose_en: Two remaining ghouls crawl along opposite walls, their jagged fangs dripping acidic venom onto the floor.
panels.prose_hi: Bache hue do pishaach vipreet diwaron par rengte han, unke dantedar daant farsh par amleey jahar tapkate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing right hand across palm
panels.action: Ha-Jun runs his ring finger along his open palm, summoning a ribbon of glowing crimson blood.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun runs his ring finger along his open palm, summoning a ribbon of glowing crimson blood.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni anamika ko apni khuli hatheli par firata hai, aur chamakte lal rakt ke ribbon ko bulata hai.

panels.action: The stream of blood swirls in an elegant vortex around his right forearm, thickening and hardening.
panels.prose_en: The stream of blood swirls in an elegant vortex around his right forearm, thickening and hardening.
panels.prose_hi: Rakt ki dhara uski dahini baanh ke charon or ek sundar bhanwar mein ghumti hai, moti aur sakht hoti ja rahi hai.

panels.action: The fluid crystallizes with a glass-like chime, forming a 40-inch single-edged katana with dark crimson fuller.
panels.prose_en: The fluid crystallizes with a glass-like chime, forming a 40-inch single-edged katana with dark crimson fuller.
panels.prose_hi: Taral padarth kaanch jaisi jhankar ke saath cristlikrit ho jata hai, jisse gahre lal rang ke fuller ke saath 40 inch ka ekal-kinare wala katana banta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers wrap around the crimson hilt, violet lightning crackling down the length of the red blade.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh talwar... mere haath ka hissa lagti hai. Koi wajan nahi, bilkul natural.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingers wrap around the crimson hilt, violet lightning crackling down the length of the red blade.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki ungaliyan lal rang ki mooth ke charon or lipati hui han, lal blade ki lambai ke neeche baingani bijli chamak rahi hai.

panels.action: Kuro flutters his wings in dark satisfaction: 'The Sanguine Fang... Sovereign ki pehli talwar!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ek bhi jhatka bekaar mat karna! Blood mana limit par hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro flutters his wings in dark satisfaction: 'The Sanguine Fang... Sovereign ki pehli talwar!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro andhere santushti mein apne pankh fadfadata hai: 'd senguin fang... sovereign ki pehli talwar!'.

panels.action: The second ghoul kicks off a wooden bookcase, jaw unhinging to bite off Ha-Jun's head.
panels.prose_en: The second ghoul kicks off a wooden bookcase, jaw unhinging to bite off Ha-Jun's head.
panels.prose_hi: Dusra pishaach lakdi ki kitabon ki almari ko laat maarta hai, uska jabda ha-jun ke sir ko kaatne ke liye khula rahata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun pivots smoothly on his left heel, the monster's teeth snapping mere millimeters past his face.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pivots smoothly on his left heel, the monster's teeth snapping mere millimeters past his face.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni bayin edi par aasani se ghumta hai, rakshas ke daant uske chehre se matra millimeter door tak tutate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun executes a lightning-fast horizontal reverse slash, leaving a luminous red crescent arc in the air.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun executes a lightning-fast horizontal reverse slash, leaving a luminous red crescent arc in the air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bijli ki teji se kshaitij reverse slash nishpadit karta hai, jisse hawa mein ek chamakdar lal ardhchandrakar chaap nikalta hai.

panels.action: The ghoul's torso is cleanly sliced into two halves, dissolving into black ash before hitting the ground.
panels.prose_en: The ghoul's torso is cleanly sliced into two halves, dissolving into black ash before hitting the ground.
panels.prose_hi: Bhut ke dhad ko safai se do hisson mein kata jata hai, jo jameen se takraane se pehle kali raakh mein ghul jata hai.

panels.action: Seeing its packmate obliterated in one strike, the third ghoul turns and frantically scrambles toward the hatch.
panels.prose_en: Seeing its packmate obliterated in one strike, the third ghoul turns and frantically scrambles toward the hatch.
panels.prose_hi: Apne packmet ko ek hi war mein nasht hote dekh, teesra ghol mudta hai aur hatch ki or bhagta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's crimson pupils dilate: 'Bhaagne nahi doonga.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar tum bahar gaye, toh innocent logon ko maar doge.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's crimson pupils dilate: 'Bhaagne nahi doonga.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki lal putliyan failti han: 'bhagne nahin dunga.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun shifts into an athletic javelin stance, the blood katana vibrating with concentrated mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun shifts into an athletic javelin stance, the blood katana vibrating with concentrated mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek athletic bhala rukh mein badal jata hai, rakt katana kendrit man ke saath kampan karta hai.

panels.shot: katana hurled like a crimson spear
panels.action: The blood blade launches through the air like a scarlet railgun beam, breaking the sound barrier.
panels.prose_en: The blood blade launches through the air like a scarlet railgun beam, breaking the sound barrier.
panels.prose_hi: Rakt blade scarlet railgan beam ki tarah hawa mein launch hota hai, jo dhwani avrodh ko todta hai.

panels.shot: blade pinning ghoul to steel door
panels.action: The blade impales the ghoul directly through the spine, pinning it three feet off the ground against the steel door.
panels.prose_en: The blade impales the ghoul directly through the spine, pinning it three feet off the ground against the steel door.
panels.prose_hi: Bled ghol ko sidhe reedh ki haddi ke madhyam se chhedata hai, aur ise steel ke darvaje ke khilaf jameen se teen feet upar pin karta hai.

panels.action: The pinned demon disintegrates into black smoke and violet sparks, leaving only the embedded crimson blade.
panels.prose_en: The pinned demon disintegrates into black smoke and violet sparks, leaving only the embedded crimson blade.
panels.prose_hi: Pin kiya hua danav kale dhuen aur baingani chingari mein vighatit ho jata hai, keval embedded crimson blade bachta hai.

panels.action: The crystalline katana dissolves back into a stream of pure crimson liquid, flowing through the air.
panels.prose_en: The crystalline katana dissolves back into a stream of pure crimson liquid, flowing through the air.
panels.prose_hi: Cristliy katana hawa mein bahte hue shuddh lal rang ke taral ki ek dhara mein wapas ghul jata hai.

panels.shot: blood stream returning to ha-jun ring
panels.action: The crimson stream spirals back into the Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger, reabsorbing completely.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Khoon wapas aa gaya... Toh main ise reuse kar sakta hoon!

panels.prose_en: The crimson stream spirals back into the Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger, reabsorbing completely.
panels.prose_hi: Lal rang ki dhara puri tarah se pun: avshoshit hokar, ha-jun ki ungli par khokhale rakt ki anguthi mein wapas sarpil ho jaati hai.

panels.action: Kuro glides down onto the pedestal: 'Khoon barbad nahi hota jab tak tum conscious ho.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Lekin agar blade toot gaya ya evaporate hua, toh tumhara biological blood chala jayega.

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides down onto the pedestal: 'Khoon barbad nahi hota jab tak tum conscious ho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro kursi par fisalta hai: 'khun barbaad nahin hota jab tak tum sachet ho.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun flexes his fingers, feeling the thrill of combat power for the first time in his life.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Pehli baar... mujhe lag raha hai ki main kamzor nahi hoon.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flexes his fingers, feeling the thrill of combat power for the first time in his life.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apne jeevan mein pehli baar yudh shakti ka romanch mahsoos karte hue apni ungaliyan modi.

panels.shot: sudden vision flash in ha-jun head
panels.action: A violent psychic flash hits Ha-Jun's mind: an ancient battlefield covered in millions of crimson swords.
panels.prose_en: A violent psychic flash hits Ha-Jun's mind: an ancient battlefield covered in millions of crimson swords.
panels.prose_hi: Ek hinsak mansik flash ha-jun ke dimag mein aata hai: ek prachin yuddhkshetra jo lakhon lal rang ki talwaron se dhaka hua hai.

panels.shot: giant silhouette on throne of blades
panels.action: A titanic shadowy king with four demonic horns sits on an iron throne made of a thousand blood blades.
panels.prose_en: A titanic shadowy king with four demonic horns sits on an iron throne made of a thousand blood blades.
panels.prose_hi: Char rakshasi seengon wala ek titanic chhayadar raja ek hajar rakt blade se bane lohe ke sinhasan par baithta hai.

panels.action: Deep thunderous voice resonating: 'My blood still cuts... my wrath still breathes.'

dialogue.text: "Mera khoon abhi bhi kaatta hai... mera krodh abhi bhi zinda hai."

panels.prose_en: Deep thunderous voice resonating: 'My blood still cuts... my wrath still breathes.'.
panels.prose_hi: Gahri gadgdahat ki awaz gunjati hai: 'mera khoon abhi bhi katata hai... mera krodh abhi bhi saans leta hai.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun stumbles backward, blinking rapidly as the dark vision shatters like stained glass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stumbles backward, blinking rapidly as the dark vision shatters like stained glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun peeche ki or ladkhadata hai aur teji se apni palkein jhapkata hai kyonki andhera drishya rangeen kaanch ki tarah bikhar jata hai.

panels.action: From Ha-Jun's belt, Min-Jae's urgent voice crackles over the handheld radio.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun! Bureau ke 3 tactical vans Insa-dong alley mein enter kar chuki hain!

panels.prose_en: From Ha-Jun's belt, Min-Jae's urgent voice crackles over the handheld radio.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki belt se, min-je ki jaruri awaz haath mein liye radio par gunjati hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun brings the radio to his lips: 'Main Relic le chuka hoon. Rasta batao.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main secure hoon. Exit 4 se bahar aa raha hoon.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun brings the radio to his lips: 'Main Relic le chuka hoon. Rasta batao.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun radio ko apne hothon par lata hai: 'main avashesh le chuka hun. rasta batao.'.

panels.action: Min-Jae types frantically on his laptop in a parked delivery van outside, monitoring radar pings.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Tunnel ventilator B-3 open hai! Wahan se roof par niklo!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae types frantically on his laptop in a parked delivery van outside, monitoring radar pings.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je bahar khadi delivery van mein apne laptop par radar ping ki nigrani karte hue, unmattata se type karta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun springs off an antique desk, kicking upward through the open ceiling ventilation shaft.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun springs off an antique desk, kicking upward through the open ceiling ventilation shaft.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek prachin desk se bahar nikalta hai, khuli chhat ke ventilation shaft ke madhyam se upar ki or badhta hai.

panels.action: Kuro follows close behind in a streak of purple smoke, chuckling softly.
panels.prose_en: Kuro follows close behind in a streak of purple smoke, chuckling softly.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro baingani dhuyen ki ek lakeer mein dhire-dhire hanste hue peeche aata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun bursts onto the rainy Seoul rooftop, city neon lights reflecting in his dual-ringed crimson eyes.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh toh bas shuruat hai. Abhi aath Relics baaki hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bursts onto the rainy Seoul rooftop, city neon lights reflecting in his dual-ringed crimson eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun seoul ki barsati chhat par aa gaya, shahar ki nean roshni uski dohri ring wali lal rang ki aankhon mein pratibimbit ho rahi thi.
